The duplicate detection in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` misses overlapping days when two statements are uploaded together. The function `dedupe` relies on exact matches of keys generated by `dedupeKey`, which joins date, amount, and description. This approach fails in cases where overlapping statements contain transactions on the same dates but may have different keys or ordering, causing duplicates to be missed in a batch upload. This is visible in the user's report where uploading two files with overlapping days did not detect duplicates, while separate uploads did.

The bug lies in how `dedupe` compares transactions by exact key membership without accounting for overlapping date ranges or batch processing nuances.

input.title: Fix missing detection of overlapping duplicate days in dedupe
input.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The deduplication logic in dedupe.ts currently misses the case where two statement files with overlapping days are uploaded together. This results in days appearing twice in the ledger without recognizing duplicates, as described in the issue. 

This pull request proposes a fix to the deduplication process to correctly handle overlapping days in such uploads, ensuring that duplicates across multiple statements in quick succession are detected and filtered out properly.
